header.title: Glow Docs Index (version-agnostic)
header.intent: Machine-readable index of documents available in this workspace; names omit version numbers.
rules: Document names in this index intentionally omit version numbers.
Use file_stem as the stable match key for any versioned filename.
Categories: canon (source of truth), reference (consultative), living (temporary superseding scratchpad), artifact (supporting artifacts/special texts).

categories.description: Single source of truth for requirements and contracts.

docs.name: PF01-Canon-HDE-Math-Spec
docs.purpose: Math-only engine spec: algorithms, scoring/banding, frozen inputs/constants, and math-side determinism definitions. Routes transport/governance and wire bytes to their owning documents.

docs.name: PF02-Canon-HDE-Architecture
docs.purpose: Architecture and component-boundary map for the HD Engine stack (engine/adapter/presenter/CLI), enforcing single-home ownership and routing semantics; notes PF10 addenda supersession where applicable.

docs.name: PF04-Canon-HDE-Governance
docs.purpose: Governance for transport/ops posture (A7 invariants, caching, conditional delivery) and the acceptance token roster; routes wire bytes and math to their single-home documents.

docs.name: PF05-Canon-HDE-CLI-API-Vendor-Ref
docs.purpose: Byte-level contracts for CLI/Reader/Aux and vendor interfaces: request/response shapes, validators, header/ETag/cache semantics, and public 'bands-only' posture rules.

docs.name: PF06-Canon-Epic-Process-Guide
docs.purpose: Epic delivery workflow for human + AI pair-coding: planning and close requirements, evidence/index updates, and repeatable process gates.

docs.name: PF07-Canon-Glow-Infrastructure
docs.purpose: Infrastructure inventory (names, environments, evidence/QA root paths) and routing map to contract/policy documents; explicitly not runbooks or behavioral semantics.

docs.name: PF09-Canon-HDE-Build Checklist
docs.purpose: Phase-based build checklist for the HD Engine with canonical task statuses, deferral conventions, and notes used to track what remains to ship.

docs.name: PF12-Canon-HDE-Schemas and Artifacts
docs.purpose: Single home for engine schemas/catalogs/manifests and governed artifact formats (canonical JSON rules, Evidence Index, and Machine Evidence Mirror).

docs.name: PF14-Canon-HDE-Mechanics-Guide
docs.purpose: Mechanics/components reference for repo structure and build tasks; defines scope boundaries (not governance/token registry, not epic planning) and key repo invariants like lowercase directories.

docs.name: PF17-Canon-HDE Narratives Guide
docs.purpose: Spec for deterministic, LLM-free narrative composition: how narrative keys map to short text outputs, suppression rules, and proof surfaces (bytes/tokens routed to their single-home documents).

docs.name: PF19-Canon-Glow-QA-Guide
docs.purpose: QA standard for pre-commit and post-commit verification across Glow/HDE, including planning boundaries and routing to HDE single-home documents (operational plan templates live in PF27).

docs.name: PF20-Canon-HDE-Phased-Epics
docs.purpose: Epic ledger mapping HDE epics to phases, including record conventions and planning posture rules (including mandatory PF23 consult).

docs.name: PF23-Canon-Reality-Audits
docs.purpose: Template and rules for reality audits: read-only descriptive repo/component audits used as planning input and post-epic truth checks.

docs.name: PF27-Canon-Plan-Templates
docs.purpose: Normative templates for plans/runbooks (for example, Live QA plans), including portability/provenance rules and evidence/rails declaration patterns.

docs.name: PF-Reference-Glow Story
docs.purpose: Product narrative explaining Glow’s user story and what the engine returns at a high level (bands + narratives; numbers reserved for admin/tuning).

docs.name: PF03-Reference-Technical-Writing-Best-Practices
docs.purpose: Writing and redline discipline for maintaining Glow/HDE documentation (reproducible changes, placement rules, canonicalization, and evidence-index update expectations).

docs.name: PF08-Reference-Human Design System
docs.purpose: Reference material for Human Design fundamentals and bodygraph structure used for internal understanding and interpretation.

docs.name: PF11-Reference-The Rave I Ching
docs.purpose: Reference material for the Rave I’Ching: gate themes, lines, and related Human Design interpretive data.

docs.name: PF13-Reference-Glow-Development-Philosophy
docs.purpose: Values and decision rubrics for Glow development to prevent drift (controlled change, single-home doctrine, audience/goal alignment); not procedures or specs.

docs.name: PF15-Reference-HDE-Copy Tonality Guide
docs.purpose: Tone and style rules for user-facing narrative copy (felt-only, bands-only, no jargon/em dashes), with routing to owning contract documents.

docs.name: PF18-Reference-HDE-Narrative Deliverables
docs.purpose: Reference pack of narrative deliverable texts organized by category/band/perspective/slot with stable IDs for content selection.

docs.name: PF21-Reference-7 Phases of Alchemical Engineering
docs.purpose: Conceptual framework naming the product’s work modes across seven phases, used to guide planning posture and decision style.

docs.name: PF22-Reference-GitHub Codespaces in a QA Workflow
docs.file_stem: PF22-Reference-GitHub Codespaces in a QA Workflow
docs.purpose: Reference on using GitHub Codespaces as a reproducible environment for QA workflows and their operational characteristics.

categories.description: Temporary superseding scratchpad, intended to be drained into canon.

docs.name: PF10-HDE-Build-Notes
docs.purpose: Living scratchpad for temporary addenda that supersede canon only where explicitly covered, meant to be drained into the proper canonical documents.

categories.description: Supporting non-PF artifacts or special texts used by the system.

docs.name: glow_dev_board_bundle
docs.purpose: Supporting machine bundle capturing the Glow Dev Board state/events used for planning/reporting; not a canonical PF specification.

docs.name: PF-Invocation
docs.purpose: Canonical invocation text used as the source string for hashing/tagging in governed artifacts.
